LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: SEQUENCING IDEAS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Writing 3.3 Handwriting (2 sessions) • Vocabulary: Descriptive words - colours •
Topic 3.4: Guided Writing: Sequencing Ideas
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing: Sequencing Ideas, part of Writing 3.3 Handwriting (2 sessions) • Vocabulary: Descriptive words - colours • in Grade 5 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why is it good to organise ideas well in writing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. create sentences from a given substitution table on parts of the day,

2. reorganise words from a given collection to form meaningful sentences,

3. reorganise jumbled up sentences to form a logical and coherent paragraph,

4. team up to play a game involving reorganizing jumbles up words to form a story. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. create sentences from a given substitution table on parts of the day,
2. reorganise words from a given collection to form meaningful sentences,
3. reorganise jumbled up sentences to form a logical and coherent paragraph,
4. team up to play a game involving reorganizing jumbles up words to form a story. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing: Sequencing Ideas together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
